desc:
Enlist as a private, or commission through ROTC, OCS or West Point, and live your Army career one week at a time.

Every week adds a line to your service log: training, deployments, promotion boards, bad coffee and the occasional decision that changes everything. Climb from Private to four-star General.

★ Every rank, E-1 to O-10, with real promotion boards and evaluations
★ 30+ mini-games: marksmanship, land nav, airborne school, sniper school and more
★ Earn ribbons, badges and medals, each with its own ceremony
★ Deploy overseas, and command a war from the map as a general
★ As a general, set policy and make leadership calls
★ A life outside the Army: relationships, family, money and a phone full of texts
★ Active Duty, National Guard or Reserve
★ Ironman mode: one career, no second chances

(the real creation date was 10/30/2026)
